purpose: Engineering audit of full programmable native SDK access. No real research-task or scientific acceptance.

batches.scope: Common native-code workflow, catalog and packaging; discovered missing dependencies/source and local compatibility gaps; selected arbitrary API programs.
Remaining local circuits, compilers, differentiable and optimization SDKs.
Remaining physics, chemistry, information, QEC, optics and network SDKs.
Platform-specific native/Julia/GPU environments and local construction using service SDKs; live cloud/hardware operations require their own authorization.

commands.note: Full default engineering check after SDK dependency updates and installed-file validation. The final PairInteraction delegated setup and Flow cold-start test budget were subsequently checked in the targeted and native runs.

commands.command: node --test tests/prepared-python.test.mjs tests/sdk-access.test.mjs tests/candidate-tools-contracts.test.mjs tests/sdk-package.test.mjs tests/pairinteraction-contracts.test.mjs
commands.note: 20 passed; includes installed-file corruption, delegated PairInteraction recovery and actual plugin packaging.
7 passed, including real package build, split runtime and relocated cached Skills.
10 SDK environments plus subprocess cancellation/resume passed; Flow/Ocean/CQLib were unprepared at this execution. Later results supersede individual failures.
Native QNN construction, symbolic parameters, gradient matrices and Adjoint API regression; no training.
Existing adapted angle-kernel Tool regression after core version update.

independentReview.scope: Independent diff and contract/package review. Eleven checks passed after adding installed-file validation. The identified PairInteraction bypass was fixed; final review checked that diff, the 20-test result, and Flow/Ocean runtime evidence. No remaining P1/P2 findings.
limitations: Classiq and Q-CTRL bootstrap imports not run in this worktree.
Flow/Ocean runtime checks were completed by the implementing agent; final review independently read their records and compared current lock hashes.

observedFailures.observation: A disk-full installation left 680 NumPy and 37 dimod files invalid while distribution metadata survived; uv sync alone did not detect them. Reinstalled the two packages at their locked versions. Generic, algorithm and delegated PairInteraction setup now validate original wheel RECORD paths and sizes before attestation.

The SciPy 1.15.2 PROPACK extension could not load on this macOS arm64 host. Pinned SciPy 1.17.1, whose PROPACK implementation is in C; full source API construction then passed. A subsequent 100-second cold-import/font-cache timeout was retained and the test-only budget increased to 300 seconds; final execution took 27.44 seconds.

Old core 1.4.0b1 plus complete old QML failed on Operation/ValueInstruction and parameter-gradient API differences. Import-only aliases were rejected. Pinned compatible upstream core 2.0.0b4 and QML 0.1.0b3; native gradient and previous Tool regressions passed.
Full pyqpanda_alg package needed additional pandas/scikit-learn imports and fmt 11 ABI. Added locked dependencies and isolated fixed-revision fmt build; full VQE/HHL/QUBO package import passed.

Large dependency downloads repeatedly timed out. Interrupted installers remained unprepared; no success marker was used. Task-owned cache moved to an external volume; any manual wheel download is verified against the committed lock before the normal frozen setup is completed.

limits: Each passed SDK row covers only its listed operations, not every public API or optional backend.
3 and 7 are engineering fixture sizes, not product limits. The native route accepts arbitrary saved user programs.
Cancellation/resume checks cover a local subprocess and saved checkpoint; no live model-driven Harness/Codex conversation or UI acceptance was run.
No external account, billable cloud job, QPU, laboratory hardware, Linux/Windows or GPU execution was verified.
Evidence directories and logs are local ignored artifacts. Committed hashes and test sources support reruns; raw outputs are not bundled in Git.
No real research-task validation; no scientific acceptance derived.
